MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable WD drive fits my interest in practical computer accessories because I could use it for backups and Raspberry Pi project files.",
    "The Fire TV Stick 4K connects with my HDMI cable and Raspberry Pi entertainment setup, while the internal SSD suggests a useful computer upgrade if it fits my hardware."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and smart plug assume I want voice control or home automation, but my recent purchases address specific computer, networking, and desk needs.",
    "The 16TB drive offers more capacity than I have a clear use for, and sport earbuds do not match the desk listening setup suggested by my headphones and under-desk mount.",
    "A tablet does not address an immediate need for me; having a Kindle does not mean I want another screen."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Amazon device purchases seem to have been taken as interest in a whole Alexa setup, even though those purchases served separate purposes.",
    "Interest in storage and audio seems to have been stretched to cover very large drives and sport earbuds without enough attention to how I would use them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My cable management, Ethernet accessories, keyboard accessories, and headphone mount suggest that improving an existing workspace matters to me right now.",
    "Compatibility and a concrete use matter: I would check the SSD connection and TV support, and I need a reason to choose a particular storage capacity.",
    "The two Fire TV sticks serve the same purpose for me; interest in both means I would compare them and choose one."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my computer and entertainment interests but stretched them into smart-home and extra-device purchases without a clear current need."
}
